title: Course platform migrations: a runner that skips some migrations for good
name: Schema migration runner

questions.prompt: Since Tuesday's deploy, the learner dashboard has been throwing 'column "progress_pct" of relation "enrollments" does not exist' in production, but works on every fresh dev and CI database. The add_enrollment_progress PR (migration 0004) was opened weeks ago and merged on Tuesday. The deploy log says 'migrate: nothing to do', and `status` lists every migration as applied. Fix migrator.ts so the tests pass.
